# Vector Assault Ingestion Pack

This pack encodes the hybrid design target for `apps/vector-assault`:

- Asteroids-derived movement/fragmentation/vector readability
- Arena-survival wave escalation and score-pressure structure

## Files

- `copilot-build-prompt.txt` — implementation-ready prompt for Copilot/Codex
- `mechanics-glossary.md` — shared vocabulary for gameplay and tuning
- `acceptance-criteria.md` — prototype definition-of-done checklist
- `todo-seeded-file-headers.md` — reusable TODO headers for major systems
